A_v0_mean_only_dependence.method: algebraic identity verified numerically at the design's frozen constants; the proof is the identity Sum_t||y_t-z||^2 = Sum_t||y_t-ybar||^2 + T||ybar-z||^2

C_F_per_chain_sufficiency_with_positive_.field_semantics: entries are [P(z_0=+1), P(z_0=-1)] for the terminal time step; chain0_from_joint marginalises the 16-state joint, chain0_independent runs the standalone two-state filter on stream 0 only

D_X_joint_not_product_of_marginals.note: J>0: independent per-chain marginals do not reconstruct the joint

E_independent_brute_force_oracle.note: second implementation: direct enumeration over all 16^4 trajectories, no shared recursion with the forward algorithm

F_condition_difficulty_gap.note: difficulty proxy for the §4.7 hard gate; a large gap means the coupling condition is also easier/harder and the primary interaction is confounded

G_stationary_law_and_marginals.note: F is uniform by construction (independent symmetric chains); X is the kernel's own stationary law, which is not p_J. Marginal priors are the quantity the ruling's same-marginals condition depends on.

limits: 这些检查只核对解析主张与实现一致性，不构成任务资格、控制余量、功效或任何架构效果证据。
B/C/E 的成立依赖 J=0 或给定的耦合矩阵与按维分解的发射模型；若改动生成器须重推。
D 只证明该 J 取值下联合后验不可由逐链边缘重建，不证明任何架构在该任务上会成功或失败。
E 在 T=4 上做枚举，是 oracle 的第二实现，不是对 T=16 运行档的独立重放。
F 的熵差只作为 §4.7 难度硬门的输入数字，不构成架构效果证据。
E 曾抓到一次真实实现缺陷：修正前的前向递推在最后一步多做一次转移（得到 z_{T+1} 的预测分布而非 z_T 的滤波后验），而 B/C/D 因两个实现共享同一约定错误无法发现。该缺陷已修，E 现为 PASS。
